rg.put_candidate.effect: Canonicalize, hash and append immutable payload; never overwrite.

rg.verify_transition.effect: Reject unknown references, missing witnesses, free-variable leakage, axiom violations, and failed Lean checks.

rg.certify.effect: Atomic admission only after all configured trusted checks succeed; attestation records verifier binary and schema digests.

security.lean: trusted toolchain and compiled source digests required
security.idempotency: repeat PUT of identical bytes returns same digest
